description: This is a C# source file that demonstrates a minimalistic example of generating a PDF document using the MigraDoc and PdfSharp libraries. It creates a document with a paragraph of text, a footer with a date, and an embedded image, then renders and saves the PDF.

classes.name: Program
classes.description: Main class containing the entry point and document creation logic.

methods.name: Main
methods.description: Entry point that creates and renders a PDF document using MigraDoc.

methods.name: CreateDocument
methods.description: Creates a minimalistic MigraDoc document with a paragraph, footer, and an image.

methods.name: AddImage
methods.description: Adds an image to the last section of the document, with specified width.
